signin.title: Sign in
signin.text: Use your mail account to continue.

magic.title: Sign in with a link
magic.text: We email you a link that signs you in. No password needed.

invite.title: Create your account
invite.text: Sign-up is invite only. Open the link from your administrator.
invite.need: You need an invite to create an account.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.text: You get a mailbox and one sign-in for every app. An invite is required.

labels.name: Full name
labels.terms: I accept the terms of use

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.text: Enter your address and we email you a reset link.
forgot.nomail: Password reset is unavailable. Contact support.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.text: The new password replaces the old one everywhere.

code.title: Two-step verification
code.text: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.

check.title: Check your email
check.text: We sent a link to the address below. It expires in 15 minutes.

verified.title: Email verified
verified.text: Your address is confirmed. You can sign in now.

signout.title: Sign out?
signout.text: You will be signed out of this browser.

nomail.title: Password reset unavailable
nomail.text: Password reset is unavailable. Contact support.

linkerror.title: This link does not work
linkerror.text: It was already used or it expired. Ask for a new one.

consent.title: Allow access
consent.text: An application wants to sign you in with your mail account.
consent.reauth: You're signed in as {account}. Enter your password to authorize this app — Stalwart needs it to mint the code.

errors.credentials: The address or the password is wrong.
errors.invite: This invite is invalid, used, or expired.
errors.expired: This password has expired. Reset it to continue.

home.title: Welcome
home.text: Manage your YSELF account, security and the sites that can sign you in.

personal.title: Personal info
personal.text: Your name and address as they appear to sites you sign in to.

security.title: Security
security.text: Password, two-step verification, app passwords and sessions.

labels.changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
labels.totpHint: Scan the otpauth URL or enter the secret in your authenticator app, then confirm with a code.
labels.appsHint: Use an app password in mail clients. It never replaces your sign-in password.
labels.appCreated: Copy this password now. It is not shown again.

apps.title: Connected sites
apps.text: Sites that can sign you in with this account. Revoke to drop their grant.

privacy.title: Data & privacy
privacy.text: Download a copy of your data, read the audit log, or delete the account and free the name.

labels.deleteHint: This destroys the mailbox, frees the username on both domains, and signs you out. Type your password to confirm.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.text: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
